Coauthorship network

Who has written papers with whom, among the Top 100

Each numbered node is a Top 100 researcher (the number is their rank), colored by region and sized by rank. A line connects two researchers who have co-authored at least one paper in the arXiv set this directory is built from; thicker lines mean more joint papers. This is the same coauthorship structure that feeds the arXiv eigenvector-centrality signal in the ranking. Drag nodes, scroll to zoom, hover for a name, click a node to select it and drag it (double-click to open its profile). Researchers with no arXiv co-authors in the set (for example those ranked mainly through zbMATH) sit apart.

● North America   ● Europe   ● Asia & Pacific   ● Other
Tip: click Freeze, then drag a node out to isolate part of the graph.
